health.title: My Health
health.disclaimer: These values are estimates based on scientific formulas. They do not replace professional health assessment.
health.completeProfileMessage: Fill in your profile to see your calculated metrics.
health.addMeasurementsHint: Add your waist, hip, and neck measurements to your profile to calculate body fat and waist-to-hip ratio.
health.bmiExplanation: Body Mass Index (BMI) is a measure that relates weight and height. It's an estimate that doesn't consider body composition (muscle vs fat).
health.bodyFatExplanation: Body fat percentage indicates how much of your weight is fat. Calculated using the US Navy method based on waist, neck, and hip measurements.
health.whrExplanation: Waist-to-Hip Ratio indicates where fat accumulates in the body. Abdominal fat (high waist) is associated with higher cardiovascular risk.
health.idealWeightExplanation: Estimated ideal weight is based on the healthy BMI range (18.5 to 24.9). It's a general reference that doesn't consider your individual body composition.
health.bmrExplanation: Basal Metabolic Rate (BMR) is the energy your body uses at complete rest, just to maintain vital functions like breathing and heartbeat.
health.bmrMessage: Energy spent at absolute rest to maintain vital functions.
health.bmrRecommendation: Never consume less than your BMR for long periods - it can harm your metabolism.
health.tdeeExplanation: Total Daily Energy Expenditure (TDEE) is how many calories you burn per day, considering your BMR and physical activity level.
health.tdeeMessage: Total calories you burn per day considering your physical activity.
health.tdeeRecommendation: This is your maintenance point - consuming this keeps your weight stable.
health.calorieTargetExplanation: Your daily calorie target is adjusted from TDEE according to your goal: deficit to lose weight, surplus to gain mass.
health.bmiStatus_underweight: Your BMI is {points} points below the healthy range.
health.bmiStatus_overweight: Your BMI is {points} points above the healthy range.
health.bmiStatus_healthy: Your BMI is within the healthy range.

health.gain_muscle_message: Surplus of {points} kcal for muscle gain.

items.a: You pay the introductory price shown on your chosen plan today. Unless you cancel, the plan renews automatically at the price listed (plus any applicable taxes) at the end of each billing period. The renewal amount and date are always shown before you confirm your order.
You can cancel any time from your account settings — no phone calls, no forms. When you cancel, access continues until the end of the period you've already paid for.
We offer an unconditional 7-day guarantee on your first order. If it isn't for you, just request a refund and we'll return your money.

items.q: Do I have to pay to start?
items.a: You create your account for free and only choose a plan when you're ready. Nothing is charged without your explicit confirmation.

items.q: Does the app work on my phone?
items.a: Yes. The app is a PWA and can be installed straight onto your phone like a native app — on Android, iOS and desktop too.

items.q: Is it right for my fitness level?
items.a: Yes. You set your goals, current level and preferences during sign-up, and the experience adapts to you. We don't replace medical advice — consult your physician before starting any program.
